goal: Reconstruct readable, editable C++ for Milestone H16 (Audio/Video/Mobiclip Subsystem), covering sound effect buffer assignment, rate/channel buffer size calculation, secondary buffer assignment, data size calculation, sample byte calculation, data base pointer derivation, data element count lookup, and status sound track ID update with offline differential validation, staging, and autonomous verification.

tasks.goal: Comprehensive static and architectural reconnaissance of Milestone H16 Audio, Voices, and Video / Mobiclip Subsystem.
acceptance: Identify exact entry points, memory structures, and callers for H16 Audio subsystems.

validation_plan: Cross-check candidate functions against pinned binary code.bin and functions.csv ledger.

tasks.goal: Independent review of H16 Audio architecture reconnaissance.
acceptance: Confirm scope boundaries, calling conventions, and offline differential test plans.
validation_plan: Verify against function signatures and registers.
